home.seo_description: Institutional portal on digital citizenship in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: online rights and duties, abuse prevention, secure reporting and references to the legal framework (Act 20/017).
home.hero_img_alt: Illustration: balance between digital citizenship and online safety
home.hero_official: Official notice: this site explains rights and duties related to the use of information and communication technologies, in line with Congolese law, in particular Act No. 20/017 on telecommunications and ICTs, and directs users to the competent authorities for remedies.
home.more_lead: Training, help and transparency: direct access to complementary sections of the portal.
home.pillars_lead: Three areas: digital rights, duties and reporting abuse. Educational content (quizzes, educational space) and digital literacy are available from the banner above or from the links below.
home.pillar_rights_text: Access, privacy, freedom of expression within the law: a clear overview.
home.pillar_duties_text: Respect for others, checking information, responsibility when publishing content.
home.pillar_report_text: Secure form to channel reports towards institutional handling and the ARPTC.

rights.seo_description: Overview of digital rights in the DRC: privacy, freedom of expression, access — legal framework including Act 20/017 on telecommunications and ICTs.
rights.title: Digital rights
rights.lead: Educational overview based on applicable law, including Act 20/017 on telecommunications and ICTs.
rights.adults_1: Access to services: within the framework set by operators and regulations, subject to legal obligations.
rights.adults_2: Privacy and data: legitimate expectations of confidentiality; processing must comply with lawfulness and security under applicable law.
rights.adults_3: Freedom of expression: exercised within limits set by the Constitution and criminal law (e.g. no incitement to hatred, defamation).
rights.adults_4: Remedies: you may contact competent authorities, including the ARPTC for its regulatory remit.
rights.minors_intro: Young people benefit from stronger protection. Parents, guardians and schools play a key role in supervising internet and phone use.
rights.minors_2: Protection against grooming and exposure to illegal or harmful content;
rights.disclaimer: This content is for general understanding only; it is not individual legal advice. For a specific situation, consult a lawyer or the competent authority.

duties.seo_description: Citizens’ duties online: respect for others, checking information and responsibility when publishing content, under Congolese law.
duties.title: Digital duties
duties.lead: Citizen responsibilities and behaviour online, in line with Congolese law.
duties.resp_2: Do not share illegal content or content that harms others;
duties.resp_3: Check information before sharing to limit disinformation;
duties.resp_4: Protect your credentials and equipment entrusted at work or school;
duties.resp_5: Report abuse honestly through the proper channels.
duties.behavior_p: Responsible use of digital tools helps collective safety: avoid escalating conflict, prefer dialogue, keep evidence in case of dispute and contact authorities rather than taking justice into your own hands.

digitalCode.seo_description: Plain-language overview of the DRC Digital Code: purpose, who it applies to, key definitions, rights and duties, e‑commerce, the role of the State, cybersecurity, and PDF download.
digitalCode.title: Digital Code (DRC)
digitalCode.lead: Educational summary: what this code is for, who it concerns, and the main rules in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

digitalCode.s1_lead: The Digital Code sets rules for:
digitalCode.s1_summary: In short, it organises the use of digital technology in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
digitalCode.s3_d1: information that can identify a person;
digitalCode.s3_d2: a service available over the Internet (app, website, mobile payment, etc.);
digitalCode.s3_d4: measures to protect systems and data;
digitalCode.s3_d5: agreement given by a person for the use of their data.
digitalCode.s4_i2: clear information about services and terms;
digitalCode.s4_i4: refuse abusive use of their data;
digitalCode.s4_i5: lodge a complaint if their rights are violated.
digitalCode.s5_f3: interrupt a service without valid justification.
digitalCode.s6_i2: provide an address and contact details;
digitalCode.s6_i4: explain payment, delivery and refund terms.
digitalCode.s6_seller: The seller is responsible for proper performance of the service or sale.
